title: Slack workspaces and messages
whyItMatters: Slack keeps downloaded files, cached channel history and the signed-in workspaces on the computer. It shows which employers and teams the person belonged to.
source: Slack desktop is an Electron app with user data in the app-data folder (per-workspace cache and downloads): https://slack.com/help
notes: Classic Slack desktop client. Slack's newer builds ship as a Microsoft Store package; check Packages under %LOCALAPPDATA% for a Slack package if this folder is absent. Cached messages are readable in the local store.
